tools.name: qimen_chart
tools.description: Cast a Qimen Dunjia (奇门遁甲, time-based chai bu) chart for a local clock date and time. Returns the four pillars, Yin/Yang Dun and Ju number, Zhi Fu / Zhi Shi, and the nine palaces with heaven/earth stems, star, door, deity, 81-pattern name, void and horse markers.

tools.name: qimen_chart_now
tools.description: Cast the Qimen Dunjia chart for the current time in an IANA timezone (default Asia/Shanghai). Use this when the user asks about a matter right now.
